BEFORE THE
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION

AND

STATE OFF OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS

INTERVENOR SUSAN BURROW’S
NOTICE OF SUPPORT FOR INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION
I, Susan Burrow, a pro-se intervenor and Party No. 456, am in strong support of the requests made by Kevin Kennedy and John Burrow for an Independent and Forensic Audit of the Permian Basin Reliability Plan, and the 2024 Regional Transmission Plan.  Because there's evidence that these plans were developed using two materially different 2024 system-wide models, it appears there are legitimate concerns as to whether all these 765 kV transmission lines are necessary. 
There's strong reason to believe that the modeling used in support of Permian Basin Reliability Plan did not include all the future generation planned for the Permian Basin, making it appear that there's a greater need for transport of power from Bell County to the Permian Basin than what actually exists.
I request the Commission grant their request, and provide an independent (meaning not conducted or influenced by any party directly within ERCOT, or ONCOR) thorough. technical and formal audit of the two plans.  
The three 765kV import paths, totaling over 1200 miles and costing ratepayers over $11 billion dollars, are threatening to take tens of thousands of acres of private and generational land across the State of Texas. The project threatens to disrupt ranching and farming operations, rural communities, and lives and dreams of impacted families.  
I request the Commission take the steps necessary to ensure that the citizens of the State of Texas are not burdened by a massive project that directly benefits powerful and rich companies, but that may not be necessary.  
The Commission should abate any further action on the three 765kV paths until an independent audit, and verification of the modeling, are completed, and any adjustments are made accordingly.  There should be appropriate legislative review, and subsequent public release of such audit.  
CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that a true and correct copy of this Notice of Support has been served on all parties of record in Docket No. 59475 in accordance with the Commission's rules and the applicable procedural schedule, on September 20, 2026.

Respectfully submitted,
Susan Burrow, Pro-se Intervenor, Docket Nos. 59475
